messages:
maya: Kickoff for ZephyrTech POC perf check. They want microburst recovery proof + per-10k-token cost. Need short run matrix + sec notes by EOD.

jon: Proposed matrix: 1) Soak 2k qps for 30m. 2) Burst 10k qps for 10s x6 (40s spacing). 3) Failover: route 25% to smaller model during 2 bursts. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, enqueue_wait_ms, avg_batch, error-rate.

keith: Ops notes: warm caches 15m before bursts, continuous batching, max_batch_ms=12. For Dedicated pin shards; tag runs `zephyr-poc`. If enqueue wait >40ms, route to fallback.

maya: Minimal smoke commands: 
python loadgen.py --mix "short:70,long:30" --prompt-len 32 --resp-len 48 --qps 2000 --duration 30m --warmup 15m --tag zephyr-poc
python loadgen.py --burst-qps 10000 --burst-duration 10 --bursts 6 --spacing 40 --out results/burst.json

jon: Ballpark cost: hosted ~$0.029 / 10k tokens under this burst mix; Dedicated reserved ~$0.015 / 10k tokens if baseline kept. We'll add burst-minute surcharge if they need many peak minutes.

sec-bot: Sec questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood-internal/sq/2277. POC requires IP allowlist; BYOK preferred, HSM optional. Audit logs available per-run.

maya: Next steps: Jon to post final runbook + cost calc by tomorrow morning. Keith to reserve a Dedicated slot and confirm reservation id. Zephyr aims for smoke + burst Wed 10:00 UTC. Tag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
